thessalonians2.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

thessalonians2.1.p1.b2.text: … because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.

thessalonians2.1.p1.b3.text: … your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.

thessalonians2.1.p2.b1.text: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.

thessalonians2.1.p2.b2.text: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,

thessalonians2.1.p3.b1.text: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well.

thessalonians2.1.p3.b2.text: This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels

thessalonians2.1.p3.b3.text: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, …

thessalonians2.1.p4.b1.text: To this end, we always pray for you, … and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,

thessalonians2.1.p4.b2.text: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, …
